data.content: Implementation complete. Branch: worktree-knots-0f9c-quarantine-pull-filter (commit 3cce93fc99f4), pushed to origin. make sanity green (fmt, clippy -D warnings, 1286 tests passing, file-size check, 95.26% coverage >= threshold). New: src/db/quarantine.rs, src/sync/apply_quarantine.rs, migration v20 (knot_sync_quarantine table), db::local_leased_knot_ids, IncrementalApplier per-knot lease filter + drain-on-unlock, SyncSummary.held_back_knots, ReplicationService pull/sync no longer defer wholesale on active leases (SyncOutcome::Deferred / SyncError::ActiveLeasesExist removed as they became unconstructed), kno-mcp sync_loop reports held-back knots. Docs (README, TAXONOMY, docs/leases.md) updated to match. Changeset added.
